title: Central Teacher Eligibility Test CTET September 2026 Exam Date
vacancyDetails: Eligibility test for Paper I (Classes I-V) and Paper II (Classes VI-VIII); this is not a recruitment vacancy notification.
qualification: Paper I: Senior Secondary with the required marks plus a qualifying Elementary Education, B.El.Ed or Special Education diploma. Paper II: Graduation or Post-Graduation with the required marks plus D.El.Ed, B.Ed, B.El.Ed, B.A./B.Sc.Ed or another qualification listed in the official eligibility bulletin.
ageLimit: No specific age limit is prescribed for appearing in CTET. Candidates should verify the latest official information bulletin for eligibility and certificate-related rules.
applicationFee: Single Paper: General / OBC / EWS Rs. 1000/-; SC / ST / PH Rs. 500/-. Both Papers: General / OBC / EWS Rs. 1200/-; SC / ST / PH Rs. 600/-. Pay through debit card, credit card, net banking or e-challan.
selectionProcess: CTET Paper I and/or Paper II written examination -> CTET certificate and eligibility as per CBSE rules
documentsRequired: Registration details, photograph, signature, identity proof, address details, educational certificates and category or disability certificate where applicable.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ctet.nic.in or the official CTET application portal
2. Read the September 2026 information bulletin
3. Select Paper I, Paper II or both papers and complete the required details
4. Upload the photograph, signature and documents, then pay the applicable fee
5. Use the correction or re-open link where applicable and save the confirmation page
shortDescription: CBSE has announced the CTET September 2026 examination date. The CTET exam will be held on 12 and 13 December 2026; check the official notice and schedule.
content:
Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) September 2026 Exam Date update. Candidates enrolled for CTET September 2026 can check the examination schedule and read the official information bulletin for Paper I, Paper II, eligibility, fee and other instructions.

CTET September 2026 Examination

Paper I: Classes I to V
Paper II: Classes VI to VIII
Exam Date: 12 and 13 December 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 11/05/2026
  • Last Date for Registration and Fee Payment: 10/06/2026
  • First Correction Window: 15-18 June 2026
  • Re-open Apply Online: 25/08/2026 to 01/09/2026
  • Second Correction Window: 07-10 September 2026
  • CTET Examination Date: 12-13 December 2026
  • Exam City Details: Before Exam
  • Admit Card: 2 days before the examination
  • Answer Key: After Exam
  • Result: October 2026

Application Fee

  • Single Paper: General / OBC / EWS Rs. 1000/-; SC / ST / PH Rs. 500/-
  • Both Papers: General / OBC / EWS Rs. 1200/-; SC / ST / PH Rs. 600/-

Eligibility

Paper I is for candidates seeking eligibility for Classes I to V and Paper II is for Classes VI to VIII. The exact eligibility code depends on the candidate's educational qualification. Read the official CTET September 2026 information bulletin before relying on any eligibility option.

How to Check the Exam Date

Download the official exam notice from the link below and check the paper, date and instructions. Candidates should use the official CTET portal for exam-city details, admit card, answer key and result updates.
